param: key (per-key payload-index gating across the index lifecycle)

oracle.statement: facet on an UNINDEXED keyword key returns 400 at every lifecycle point (before any index, and again after its index is deleted); facet on an indexed keyword key returns 200 with hits; any 200-on-unindexed-key = Type1_IllegalSuccess, any 400-on-indexed-key = Type1_IllegalSuccess (rejection of legal input), 5xx with /healthz alive = Type3_RuntimeFailure
